name: quran-turn
description: Read the Qur'an while Codex takes its turn. Offline, no account, no tracking.

interface.shortDescription: Read the Qur'an while Codex works
interface.longDescription: Opens a quiet local Qur'an reader when you send a prompt, pauses when Codex needs your approval, and saves your exact ayah when the turn ends. The Tanzil Uthmani text ships verbatim and is checksum-verified before it renders. Fully offline; no account, sync or analytics.
